instruction:
Normalized IFC4 Office Migration

Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to migrate /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc into a normalized IFC4 office model. You may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Save the completed model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. The final hierarchy must contain one IfcProject named Normalized IFC4, one IfcSite named Default Site, one IfcBuilding named Default Building, and two storeys named Ground Floor and Upper Floor. Include two spaces, eight walls, two slabs, one roof, and one wall type named ExtWallType-A. Do not include doors, windows, proxies, furniture, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique.

Create spaces named GF Office and UF Office, each with dimensions 9.40 m by 7.40 m by 2.80 m. Keep wall names W-S, W-S-UP, W-N, W-N-UP, W-W, W-W-UP, W-E, and W-E-UP. W-S, W-S-UP, W-N, and W-N-UP must each be 10.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m; W-W, W-W-UP, W-E, and W-E-UP must each be 0.20 m by 8.00 m by 3.00 m. Name the slabs GF Slab and UF Slab, each 10.00 m by 8.00 m by 0.20 m. Name the roof Roof and make it 10.00 m by 8.00 m by 0.25 m. Spatially assign all spaces, walls, slabs, and the roof to either Ground Floor or Upper Floor. Other representation details may vary.
